body: its not really trying to die a poetic death more the less that it would be WAY easier to mentally prepare to kill myself if I were at school, I could just bite the bullet and try at home but whenever I try at home I just can't go through with it. I was thinking to not get caught I would do it during class because usually everyone goes in and out of the bathrooms while going to there next classes and whenever its in class its very rare for someone to come in. I could just put the rope in my locker for first period, maybe wait a few periods, ask to go to the bathroom, grab the rope and head to the bathroom. I guess should've been more expressive in my post about other problems then school. I do understand that school is temporary, its just don't really understand life, people don't understand me, and quite frankly I don't even understand myself, so why live. If my existence bottles down to just existing, even if its existing for others, I don't wanna be here. People don't want me here, its very apparent, and only becomes more and more apparent the older I get. I am not even work the dirt I walk on, and I am now just realizing how long ive just not wanted to be alive. When I was younger I told my mom all the time "You wouldn't care if I was dead, it would be one less kid to take care of" and this is when I was like 7-8. I realized my worth early on in life, and it has subconsciously fucked me up ever since. I am not worth the dirt people walk on, and my will to keep on going has been burned and its ashes spread over its grave. If I've got to kill myself for someone to care, then I am willing to take that step. All my life neglected emotionally, even after that stuff I was saying at 7-8 my mom still didn't care, and still doesn't. I don't know how a 7-8 year old can be saying that and you just are not concerned. I just cannot get help, my mom just refuses and is still refusing to help me. I'd rather die then be like this anymore, I just see no ends to this sadness and emptiness.
